title: The Intervention Gap in Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.29998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planning-time intervention fidelity is a distinct, measurable property of a learned world model: whether the model's own open-loop transitions move task variables the way matched environment interventions do. In the settings we test, it is neither revealed by reward fit nor ensured by task-anchored training. Across released TD-MPC2 checkpoint sizes, episode return falls as an operator-error diagnostic on task observables grows, while reward-prediction error stays small and nearly flat, and a self-supervised world model trained without task signal preserves the same operator substantially better than a task-anchored model on the shared task. A capture-gated matched-intervention audit then localizes what fails. On Cheetah, three LeWorldModel checkpoints capture the current task query and support decodable real intervention effects; however, their imagined five-step effects are worse than predicting no effect and worse than an environment-e

translated_title: 潜在世界模型中的干预鸿沟
translated_abstract: 规划时干预保真度是学习到的世界模型的一个独特且可测量的属性：即模型自身的开环状态转移是否能以与匹配的环境干预相同的方式移动任务变量。在我们测试的设置中，这一属性既不能通过奖励拟合来揭示，也不能通过任务锚定的训练来保证。在已发布的各种规模的TD-MPC2检查点上，随着任务可观测变量上操作误差诊断指标的增大，回合回报随之下降，而奖励预测误差始终保持很小且几乎平坦；此外，一个在没有任务信号情况下训练的自监督世界模型，在共享任务上对同一操作者的保留效果显著优于任务锚定模型。随后，一种由捕获门控的匹配干预审计进一步定位了失败之处。在Cheetah环境中，三个LeWorldModel检查点能够捕获当前任务查询并支持可解码的真实干预效应；然而，它们想象出的五步干预效应却比预测“无效应”更差，也比环境产生的真实效应更差（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“规划时干预保真度”这一新的可测量属性，证明世界模型的奖励拟合优度与任务锚定训练都无法保证其对环境干预效应的预测能力，并通过匹配干预审计揭示现有潜在世界模型想象出的多步干预效应甚至劣于预测“无效应”的基线。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces "planning-time intervention fidelity" as a distinct, measurable property of learned world models, showing that neither reward fit nor task-anchored training ensures it, and uses a capture-gated matched-intervention audit to reveal that latent world models' imagined multi-step intervention effects can be worse than simply predicting no effect.
